reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget bottles at home and live out of my tote. The 'every batch lab-tested' QR is a nice extra, but the sachet is what gets me to try one box.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so if it does nothing I will not reorder.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real reviews from other moms saying it helped their sleep or cramps, or a cheaper first box to try.
